english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the core or deepest central part of something.
Use 核心 as the all-purpose choice for the key or central part, including a CPU core in technical contexts.
This is the all-purpose choice for a central core or the initial core of a larger project or collection.
Use this for the essential core or central point of a matter, especially in more formal or analytical contexts.

examples.english: The innermost part of this plan is helping local residents.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃嘅核心係幫街坊。
